name: Approach
description: It is 8 a.m. on a Saturday in late July and the Martin family is leaving Lyon for the Alps. Camille comes down to the residential car park with a bag in each hand and her phone in her pocket; her father Jacques follows a few steps behind with his small suitcase. As she walks between the rows of cars, the E-Space recognises her phone from about ten metres away. The floating logo at the front starts to pulse softly, the rear light bar sweeps from left to right and a warm light comes up inside the cabin, so they know which car is theirs before they even look for it.
trigger_text: The proximity sensors detect Camille's phone.

name: Unlock
description: When Camille is about a metre and a half from the car, the doors unlock and open on their own, and a short welcome chime plays from the seat speakers. With both hands full, she does not have to put anything down or look for a key: she slides the bags straight onto the flat floor behind the front seats. Jacques waits next to the rear door, which has opened for him as well.
trigger_text: Camille is within 1.5 m of the car.

name: Jacques boards
description: Jacques is 72 and usually dreads getting into tall cars: high sills, low roofs, nothing to hold on to. Here the floor is flat and lit from below, with no sill to step over, so he simply walks in and takes his seat in the second row. Camille keeps an eye on him from outside, ready to help, but he does not need her. The chime has stopped and the cabin is quiet again.
trigger_text: The rear door is opened.

name: Doors close
description: Once everyone is inside, the doors close and the car checks that they are all shut. The openR panoramic screen wakes up across the whole dashboard and greets each passenger by name, Camille at the front and Jacques behind. Jacques fastens his seat belt and smiles at seeing his name: the cabin already feels more like a living room than a car.
trigger_text: All doors are closed.

name: Wheel deploys
description: Camille presses Start on the central touchscreen. The car only accepts because all the doors are closed and the gear selector is still in P. The half steering wheel, stowed in the dashboard until now, slides out towards her and locks in place in its normal driving ratio. It is steer-by-wire, with no mechanical link to the wheels, so Camille watches it come out and waits a second to make sure it is firmly in position before she takes it.
trigger_text: Camille presses Start. Only if all doors are closed and the gear selector is in P.

name: Ready to go
description: Camille selects D. The welcome lights fade out, the rear light bar switches to its driving signature and the ambient lighting dims to a calmer drive mode. The openR screen switches to navigation, with the route to the Alps already loaded. Nothing to adjust, nothing to search for: they drive out of the car park and the holiday has started.
trigger_text: Camille selects D.

name: Shared music
description: An hour after the charging stop, the E-Space is cruising on the motorway. Jacques has taken the front passenger seat and the mobile console has been left in the middle of the cabin so that everyone can reach the snacks. The same playlist plays from every seat speaker. Camille likes it, Léa finds it boring, and Jacques starts to find it too loud: an hour of somebody else's music is long.
trigger_text: The car is driving (gear selector in D).

name: Léa starts a game
description: In the second row, Léa presses Start on the game buttons of the console. Her game launches, but its sound now competes with the playlist. Camille is glad that Léa is busy and no longer asking when they will arrive, but for Jacques the cabin is getting noisy.
trigger_text: Léa presses Start on the console games. The console is in the centre position.

name: Personal audio zones
description: Jacques taps Audio zones on the central touchscreen. The seat speakers split the sound: Léa gets her game sound in her own seat, Camille keeps the music and the navigation, and Jacques sets his seat to silence. Nobody had to ask anybody to turn anything off, and the cabin feels calm again.
trigger_text: Jacques taps Audio zones on the touchscreen.

name: Navigation instruction
description: Five hundred metres before their exit, the navigation system raises an instruction. For a few seconds, every other sound is turned down in all the seats so that Camille hears the instruction clearly. Léa barely notices her game sound dipping, and Jacques hears the voice faintly in the background.
trigger_text: The navigation raises an instruction.

name: Back to personal zones
description: As soon as the instruction ends, each passenger gets their own audio back exactly as it was. Camille takes the exit with confidence, Léa carries on playing as if nothing had happened, and Jacques goes back to his silence for the rest of the trip.
trigger_text: The navigation instruction ends.

name: City driving
description: A week after the holidays, back in Lyon, Camille drives alone through the narrow streets of the city centre to go shopping. The steering is in its normal ratio and the openR screen shows the navigation. With delivery vans, scooters and pedestrians everywhere, there is a lot to watch.
trigger_text: The car is driving (gear selector in D).

name: Enter the car park
description: She turns into an underground car park. The ramps are tight and the spaces are narrow, with concrete pillars between the cars. The parking sensors start to detect obstacles around the car and the openR screen switches to a parking view showing the car from above. In a vehicle this size, Camille finds this kind of place stressful.
trigger_text: The parking sensors detect obstacles around the car.

name: Parking ratio
description: Camille spots a free space between a pillar and a parked car and selects R. Because the speed is below 10 km/h, the steer-by-wire system switches the half wheel to a much more direct parking ratio: a small movement is enough to turn the wheels fully. She no longer has to cross her hands or turn the wheel several times, and she is surprised how little she has to move.
trigger_text: Camille selects R. Only below 10 km/h.

name: Obstacle close
description: As she reverses, a pillar comes within 30 cm of the rear bumper. The parking sensors detect it as a close obstacle and an alert sounds from the driver's seat speakers. Camille stops just in time. She would like a clearer indication of the remaining distance, to know whether she could still move back a little.
trigger_text: The parking sensors detect an obstacle closer than 30 cm.

name: Parked
description: Camille straightens the car and selects P. The parking sensors go back to idle, the alert stops and the half wheel starts to retract into the dashboard. She lets go of it, relieved to have parked first time in a space that would have taken her several attempts in her previous car.
trigger_text: Camille selects P.

name: Goodbye
description: Camille gets out with her bags and walks away. When the doors lock from outside, the car finishes stowing the wheel, switches off the openR screen and the ambient lighting, and says goodbye with a slow fade of the front logo and the rear light bar. She does not need to turn around to check: she knows the car is locked.
trigger_text: The doors are locked from outside.

name: Park at the charger
description: Two hours after leaving Lyon, the battery is down to 18% and the navigation has planned a stop at a fast-charging station on the motorway. Camille pulls into a free bay and selects P. The rear lights go off and the openR screen switches to a charging view showing the battery level and the power available at this charger. In the back, Léa asks for the third time whether they are there yet, and Camille wonders how long they are going to be stuck here.
trigger_text: Camille selects P.

name: Plug in
description: Hugo gets out and plugs in the cable. Charging starts straight away: the floating logo at the front pulses slowly and the rear light bar fills up like a progress gauge, visible from the other side of the car park. On his phone, the companion app confirms the session and gives an estimate of 25 minutes to reach 80%. Now that they have a clear time, the question is what to do with it.
trigger_text: The charging cable is connected and charging starts.

name: Ask for lounge mode
description: Rather than queueing at the cafeteria, Hugo taps Lounge on the central touchscreen. The car only accepts because it is parked in P. First, the half steering wheel retracts into the dashboard to free up space at the front. Hugo is not sure the car is allowed to move things while it is charging, so Camille lets go of the wheel and checks that nobody has a hand in the way.
trigger_text: Hugo taps Lounge on the touchscreen. Only if the gear selector is in P.

name: Seats swivel
description: Before moving anything, the seat area sensors check that no feet, bags or hands are in the path of the second-row seats. Once the area is clear, and still only in P, the two seats slowly turn 180° to face the third row. Léa stays seated while her seat turns and laughs; she already wants to do it again. For the first time since they left, the whole family is sitting face to face.
trigger_text: The seat area is clear. Only if the gear selector is in P.

name: Console to the centre
description: As soon as the seats are locked in their new position, the mobile console slides back to the middle of the cabin, within everyone's reach. Its cooler compartment is already cold, the built-in games light up with their menu and the ambient lighting turns warmer. The openR screen switches to a lounge home page with music and the remaining charge time. Camille takes a cold drink, Hugo answers two emails on the console and Léa picks a game: the stop has become the nicest part of the trip.
trigger_text: The seats are locked in lounge position.

name: Charge complete
description: After 25 minutes, the battery reaches its target charge. The companion app notifies Camille and Hugo, and the logo at the front stops pulsing. Nobody is in a hurry: Léa asks for five more minutes to finish her game, and Camille is happy to let her, now that she knows exactly how much time they have.
trigger_text: The battery reaches the target charge.

name: Back to drive configuration
description: Hugo unplugs the cable and Camille taps Ready to go. The car only starts to rearrange the cabin once it has checked that the cable is disconnected. The console slides back to the front, the cooler and the games switch off, the seats turn back to face the road and the half wheel comes out again in its normal driving ratio. The lighting returns to drive mode, the navigation reappears on the openR screen and the rear light bar shows its driving signature. Camille, who was wary at first, trusts the car more now that she has seen it check before every movement.
trigger_text: Camille taps Ready to go. Only once the charging cable is disconnected.
